description: This file defines a jQuery plugin 'bootstrapSwitch' for creating toggle switch UI components, including initialization, state management, and event handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the bootstrap switch component, setting up DOM elements, event handlers, and state based on data attributes.

methods.name: toggleActivation
methods.description: Toggles the activation state of the switch (active/inactive).

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the switch is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the switch to active or inactive based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the switch to a specific state (true for on, false for off).

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current checked state of the switch.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the switch enhancements and restores the original checkbox element.
